scope: Shipping route logic only; not a substitute for native-browser QA

checks.name: Report keeps exact event and encoded matchup filter context
Direct numeric ESPN alias remains exact and unknown tab defaults to Overview
External, malformed and unsupported return destinations stay within team research
Legacy team-report deep link does not create a Back reopen loop
A second report preserves original return context instead of nesting reports
Missing game and malformed team never mutate the current route
Every implemented report tab and legitimate Home/NFL/Steelers return stays intact
Back/forward report dispatch does not add history entries
Report aliases dispatch to the report controller and only the matching page is visible
A legacy team redirect emits the actual report route without a stale team event
Unknown unrelated routes retain the existing safe Home fallback
